To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the ephemerity of fashion design is an important element in scenario thinking, (2) the ephemeral transformations of fashion design are an important aspect in scenario thinking, and (3) scenario thinking and fashion are linked through ephemerality.

(1) scenario thinking and fashion are both ephemeral; (2) fashion design is a suitable tool for the exploration and communication of future visions; and (3) the ephemeral nature of fashion design can contribute to the development of scenario planning.

(1) fashion design scenarios can be used for exploring the ephemeral future of fashion, (2) fashion design scenarios are a useful method to study the ephemerally of contemporariness and (3) fashion design can be used to study the ephemeral future.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of ephermerality and the temporariness of fashion design in the context of scenario thinking.
the role of ephermerality in scenario thinking and the implications this has for scenario design and decision making.
the ephemeral nature of contemporary scenarios and how it may be addressed in scenario design.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
fashion designers and scenario planners can learn from each other and benefit from the other's approach to design and decision making.
the ephemeral nature of fashion design scenarios can provide a valuable contribution for scenario planning and decision-making.
the fashion industry can provide a new and innovative perspective on the future and that scenario planning can provide the fashion industry with a new and innovative approach to the future.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
scenario thinking can be used in fashion design to create ephemeral futures.
scenario thinking and fashion-design thinking can be linked to each other through the concept of ephemerally.
fashion is a powerful way to explore the ephemeral futures.
The main takeaway from our work is that
fashion design scenarios are not only about fashion, but also about the future of fashion.
the ephemeral transformations in scenarios can be seen as the result of the interplay of different types of fashion design transformations.
the ephemerally oriented scenario planning can provide an opportunity to design and shape the present, as well as the future, by exploring and designing ephemeral futures.
